provenance_conflict.source_claim: Amarsi 2018 section 2.1 page 4 calls Hibbert 1991 oscillator strengths experimental.

provenance_conflict.disposition: Retain contradictory source statements. RYA-1352 primary-origin rule governs: theoretical/evaluated, not laboratory gf. No grade or canonical production input changed.
